title: Database OOM killed, no restart policy
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the PostgreSQL container as the faulty part, the memory/OOM problem, and the recent API deployment as the trigger.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL container was OOM‑killed (signal 9) due to insufficient memory, which was triggered by the recent API deployment that increased query memory usage.
truth: A new analytics endpoint in api 2.3.2 ran a massive query that pushed PostgreSQL over its 1 GB memory limit, causing the kernel to OOM-kill it. The database container has no restart policy, so it stayed down.
